implementation.targetScope: ProseMirror transform 1.12.5 position mapping, reversible steps, mark restoration, schema-aware edits and range fitting; Tiptap 2.11.7 application command controls against transform 1.12.5 and app 1.11.0. Complete editor integration, IME and collaborative server acceptance are separate. A separately reproduced deleteRange expansion drops an empty paragraph; full cross-block deletion parity remains a follow-up.

changes: Independent schema-automaton fitting over persistent subtrees and boundary events, preserving untouched content.

Compatible list suffixes join without flattening nested lists; empty text tails retain the insertion cursor before reconstructed shells. Verified by 64 variants, expanded caller fuzzing, EditorState undo and packed Tiptap browser checks.
Mirrored mapping supports undo and rebasing; mark inverses restore prior formatting rather than blindly toggling it.
Serialized step positions must be nonnegative safe integers; step registration uses a Map, so inherited names cannot select constructors.
One VPM runtime dependency: vprosemirror-model 1.25.12. No upstream runtime files shipped.
